state:
**Goal `ext-image`, Stage 4 (the pipeline) is under way.** The design is settled by ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; no session re-decides one.

The image component is embedded, typed into every compile and callable with no `nvs.toml` (`crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` module doc). `run` and `variants` decode every roster format inside the guest under the cap, orient and convert to sRGB (`extensions/image/src/decode.rs` module doc), run every pixel step but `composite` and `text` in order (`extensions/image/src/ops.rs` module doc, which also says what each step means where ADR 0120 leaves it open), and encode JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF and AVIF (`extensions/image/src/encode.rs`). Step options are checked before the decode, and every frame a step makes is held to the pixel cap.

`crates/nvs-ext/tests/image_pipeline.rs` has eleven passing tests, so every Stage 4 `cargo-named` check is green. What is left of Stage 4 is the `Novis\Image` builder (Novis source half) and the five `.nvst` cases of check `image-the-builder-runs-and-refuses`. A `composite` step, an overlay and a source other than encoded bytes still return `runtime`.

items.text: **The `Novis\Image` builder, Novis source half** (`rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`, ADR 0120 § 2's table) — `Image`, `Color` and the enums as Novis source carried in `nvs.source`; `crates/nvs-ext/build.rs:183` packs the built-in `.nvsx` with no Novis source yet, and the manifest is `extensions/image/manifest.json:1`. A step crosses as `['resize' => [...]]` (`wit/image.wit:232`).

**The five `.nvst` cases** of check `image-the-builder-runs-and-refuses` (`rule:core-classes/image-pipeline`) — under `tests/conformance/novis/` and `tests/conformance/reject/`, beside `tests/conformance/novis/image-info-answers-with-no-configuration.nvst:1`.

backlog: `composite` with the overlay table, and the `canvas`, `pixels` and `text` sources (`extensions/image/src/lib.rs` module doc); `fromRaw` needs the `pixels` source.
`blur` and `sharpen` cost O(pixels × sigma), bounded only by the request's CPU cap (`extensions/image/src/ops.rs` module doc).
A plain CMYK (Adobe transform 0) JPEG is converted by the branch in `extensions/image/src/decode.rs` that no test reaches: no tool here writes one (ImageMagick writes YCCK).
Stage 5: the `image_guest` bench test target in `nvs-ext` (goal `ext-image`'s record).
Stage 6: `nvs meta --json` lists the built-in components' classes, and the proofs roster's `novis/` paths (`crates/nvs-cli/src/meta.rs`, `tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts`).
